page.layout: One page of handwritten manuscript text in the centre column, with short marginal annotations at the left and right edges. A two-line fragment of text sits at the foot of the page, separated from the main block by a tear. No printed page furniture.

main_text.p: Linea Una et Incurva recta est.
Linea recta curva est Incontinuabilis seu non pt ea Una et eadem.
Linea Una et non-recta curva est.
Linea Curva, aequa est quia Una est qd in magis aequum et aequabile quia est Unum est.
In naâ Nihil In-naturaliter, tollit naâ ... naaly est qui ... Unum
nat la loy du plus fort est une loy sans Raison.
fiearn Congruit quid finis ... [illegible, ~12 letters] Jus ... Radicat et Rationis.
Naat congruit quid sec.Jus regulae. Jus-prudentiae
La loi ... d'une loy Esprit, et Je ... [illegible, ~10 letters] des ... Idees.
de irregulare resolubile est in regularitatem Causarum suarum nihil evadit regulam.

page.notes: Handwritten, not printed. Much of the text is cursive and abbreviated; readings are tentative and marked [?] where unsure. The French lines and the marginal annotations at the right and left are especially uncertain. Line breaks and the placement of marginal notes are approximate. The lower block is set off by a tear and may be a separate fragment.
